dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit sharp gradient transitions from dark perimeters to light centers; the most distinct is a large, irregular annulus located mid-dorsal with high-contrast edge definition.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of localized, small, high-intensity white pixel clusters scattered across the lower-anterior and mid-lateral regions, lacking internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A primary geometric relationship is formed by a large polygon connecting the centroid of the anterior-lateral scar to the centroids of the three largest mid-dorsal macro-annuli.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large circular lesion on the anterior-lateral flank containing a series of five distinct, parallel, horizontal white linear marks (hatching pattern).
other_distinctive_markers: Unique internal parallel hatching pattern situated within the perimeter of the primary circular anomaly.
